newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - June 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - June 4.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi foreign minister signals Saudi Arabia might boycott the ecomomic summit in Qatar if Israel did not change its policy on Middle East peace.
- Tunisia completes privatising the hotel sector. It offered the Hilton hotel for sale on Tuesday.
- Saudi Faqeeh group to invest 500 million riyals on tourism projects in Jeddah.
- Saudi Crown Prince Abdullah holds talks on Middle East peace process with Egyptian President Mubarak in Cairo.
- Britain rejects giving visas to five Iraqi officials.
- Morocco offers 20 percent of a silver mine worth 650 million dirhams for sale.
- White Cement Company to be set up in Saudi Arabia with a capital of 300 million riyals.
